ColdFusion Gets a Lot of Flack

I've been using Adobe ColdFusion for many years. It's been around for over 30 years.

But here's the thing: The language isn't what matters.

What matters is what you can build with it.

I've used ColdFusion for application development, automation, API integrations, data processing, security tooling and web applications.

My current website is still heavily built around ColdFusion.

I'm not interested in arguing about whether one language is "better" than another. I'll figure out how to build the solution.
